answer: Each identity runs one grove forge, locks a 70-credit bond, and casts a hollow ingot from grove charcoal per epoch. A beacon pings at random; the keeper files the serial, key-signed, in 10 minutes. A cold forge casts no hollow ingot; reuse burns the bond. The kth forge costs 34+6(k-1), one keeper per forge; 1,000 fakes cost 3,031,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented forges fail: serials carry the owner's key. Honest keepers pay 34 once, reclaiming it.
